components.name: Shutter
components.description: The one capture action: magenta pill with cream ring, the largest control on screen.
components.html: <button class="ds-shutter" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 8.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 6h1.8l1.4-2h4.6l1.4 2h1.8A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 20 8.5v8A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 17.5 19h-11A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4 16.5v-8Z M12 15.5a3.2 3.2 0 1 0 0-6.4 3.2 3.2 0 0 0 0 6.4Z"/></svg>Tag kort!</button>
components.css: .ds-shutter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; min-width: 340px; height: 108px; padding: 0 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--magenta, #ff4fd8); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); font-family: 'Lilita One', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px var(--cream, #fff7e0), 0 16px 36px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.42); transition: transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s; } .ds-shutter svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; } .ds-shutter:active { transform: translateY(3px) scale(0.98); box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px var(--cream, #fff7e0), 0 6px 16px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); } .ds-shutter:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Pill
components.description: Primary non-capture action (Print, Del): gold with navy label and icon.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; height: 72px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s, background-color 0.2s; background: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); } .ds-pill svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-pill:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Quiet Pill with Count
components.description: Navigation and secondary actions; the booth's Samling button carries a gold count badge.
components.css: .ds-pill-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; height: 72px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s, background-color 0.2s; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); color: var(--cream, #fff7e0); } .ds-pill-quiet svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-pill-quiet:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-count { min-width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); display: grid; place-items: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Danger Pill
components.description: Two-tap delete: coral tint at rest, solid coral once armed.
components.css: .ds-pill-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; height: 72px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s, background-color 0.2s; background: rgb(255 107 90 / 0.16); color: #ffb3aa; } .ds-pill-danger svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-pill-danger.armed { background: var(--danger, #ff6b5a); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); } .ds-pill-danger:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill-danger:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Type Chip
components.description: Card-type picker: pill with a type-gradient disc and filled element glyph; gold when chosen.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 420px; padding: 16px; background: var(--navy, #141a4d); } .ds-chip { height: 84px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 0 18px 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 42px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); color: var(--cream, #fff7e0); font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); animation: ds-pick 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.6, 0.5, 1); } .ds-chip-disc { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--c1), var(--c2)); } .ds-chip-disc svg { width: 30px; height: 30px; } @keyframes ds-pick { 0% { transform: scale(0.9); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

components.name: Effect Chip
components.description: Effect picker: translucent disc with a stroked icon; chosen state is gold with a navy disc and gold icon.
components.css: .ds-chips-fx { padding: 16px; background: var(--navy, #141a4d); max-width: 420px; } .ds-chip-fx { width: 100%; height: 84px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 0 18px 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 42px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); color: var(--cream, #fff7e0); font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-chip-fx:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip-fx:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-chip-fx[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-fx-disc { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); } .ds-chip-fx[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-fx-disc { background: var(--navy, #141a4d); color: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); } .ds-fx-disc svg { width: 30px; height: 30px; }

components.name: Card Back
components.description: The start card and flip back: navy pinwheel, double gold border, tilted gold title, drifting foil.
components.css: .ds-card-back { position: relative; height: 420px; aspect-ratio: 5 / 7; border: 0; border-radius: 5.2% / 3.7%; color: var(--cream, #fff7e0); font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, transparent 0 34%, rgb(255 207 31 / 0.14) 34.4% 35%, transparent 35.4%), repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, var(--navy-3, #2f3a94) 0 10deg, var(--navy-2, #232c78) 10deg 20deg); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 14px var(--gold, #ffcf1f), inset 0 0 0 18px var(--gold-deep, #e0a800), 0 24px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); display: grid; place-content: center; text-align: center; gap: 0.6em; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-card-back::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(115deg, #4ef0ff 0%, #ff4fd8 30%, #ffe14d 55%, #4ef0ff 80%, #ff4fd8 100%); background-size: 300% 300%; mix-blend-mode: color-dodge; opacity: 0.22; animation: ds-drift 9s linear infinite; pointer-events: none; } .ds-card-back:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-card-back:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--cyan, #4ef0ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-cb-title { font-family: 'Lilita One', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; color: var(--gold, #ffcf1f); text-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); transform: rotate(-6deg); } .ds-cb-sub { font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; } @keyframes ds-drift { to { background-position: 300% 300%; } }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Brief status message: cream plate with navy Baloo 800 text, bottom-centre.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-block; background: var(--cream, #fff7e0); color: var(--navy, #141a4d); font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); }

narrative.overview:
Every photo is minted as a holo trading card, and the whole app is the binder the card lives in. The ground is deep binder navy; the objects on it are gold card stock, holo foil and cream plates. The live camera is not a viewfinder but the art window of an upright 5:7 card, and the card is always the largest thing on screen.

Density is low and controls are huge: two columns of six fat chips flank the card, one magenta pill under it is the largest control, and every label is a short Danish word backed by an icon. Everything on the card itself (gold stock, type-coloured panel, cream mat, navy ribbon, cream stats plate) is drawn on canvas on a fixed 1000 x 1400 grid, so the live preview, the saved JPEG and the print are the same object.

Motion belongs to the card: a foil sweep on the live card, a 3D flip reveal after capture, tilt and a finger-tracked foil highlight on the finished card. Chrome only answers touches with a press-scale and a springy pick.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ground, gold and cream objects, magenta reserved for the one capture action.
One upright 5:7 card as the hero on every screen except the gallery grid.
Six card types, each a saturated light/dark pair plus a filled element glyph.
Lilita One for everything a kid reads at a distance; Baloo 2 heavy for labels.
Pills and discs everywhere in the chrome; card-proportioned rounded rectangles for cards.

rules.name: The One Magenta Rule
rules.body: Solid magenta fills only the capture pill. Everything else that is chosen or primary is gold.

rules.name: The Lyn Exception Rule
rules.body: Lyn is the only light type: its ink, glyph and footer flip to navy, and its chip disc icon is navy. Any new type with a light -dark tone must declare navy ink the same way.

rules.name: The Card-Furniture Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase Baloo 800 appears only inside the drawn card (ribbon, stat label, set mark), as trading-card printing. App chrome is sentence case.

rules.name: The Stroke-Under Rule
rules.body: Display text laid over the live photo (countdown numeral, "Smil!") carries a navy -webkit-text-stroke with paint-order: stroke fill, so it reads over any face.

rules.name: The Objects-Lift Rule
rules.body: Only cards, the shutter, the chosen chip and the toast cast shadows. Quiet pills, unselected chips and headings sit flat on the navy.

dos: **Do** keep the card the largest object on any screen, at 5:7, with the 0 24px 60px card-lift shadow.
**Do** draw anything that belongs to the card on the 1000 x 1400 canvas grid so preview, JPEG and print match.
**Do** mark the chosen option in gold with navy text; keep solid magenta for the capture pill only.
**Do** pair every control word with an icon from the two authored sets: filled element glyphs or stroked UI icons at 2.2.
**Do** put new controls in pills or chips of at least 72px height, with press-scale feedback.
**Do** stroke display text in navy whenever it sits on the live photo.
donts: **Don't** use uppercase labels or small tracked captions in app chrome; caps belong only to card furniture.
**Don't** add hard offset shadows or coloured glows; depth is soft black lift and the foil layer.
**Don't** introduce square or slightly rounded rectangles in chrome; chrome is pills and discs.
**Don't** animate chrome beyond press-scale, the chip pick, the countdown and the result panel's rise-in (0.6s after the flip); ambient motion belongs to the card's foil.
**Don't** set a type's ink to cream when its -dark tone is light (see The Lyn Exception Rule).
